note: Admin-only Game Economics workspace. Raw ideas land here first, get fine-tuned, and only move to 'ready' when finalized; a ready item is then promoted into the normal changelog roadmap (planned / in-progress).

items.title: Token and NFT launches excluded: earned lootbox-style surprises instead
items.summary: Never launch a token or sell NFTs. Rewards are earned and randomly discovered, opened to unlock surprises such as bonus points, easing web2 players into web3 without the token/NFT crash taste.
notes: Do NOT launch a token: token launches usually crash the project; bad actors shift focus to 'token must always go up'; when the token goes down they label the project a scam and the USP evaporates. Token launch is OUT.
Do NOT launch NFTs for sale either: same crash pattern and same scam-labeling risk.
Instead: rewards are EARNED and randomly discovered (lootbox-style), opened to unlock surprises like bonus points within the games.
Possibly some in-game rewards can unlock an NFT (earned, never sold) as the web3 collectible layer.
Goal: gradually ease web2-native folk game players into web3 without the bad taste of token/NFT value crashes.
Open questions (fine-tune next): lootbox anti-farming rules, loot RNG fairness (must run through the same on-chain VRF), legal framing of lootboxes.

items.title: Three point ledgers: global lifetime / global spendable / per-game
items.summary: One win updates three ledgers: a permanent lifetime record, the spendable balance, and the detailed per-game record that proves skill in that game.
notes: GLOBAL LIFETIME: non-spendable, permanent. Every point from every source (won, bought, giveaway, referral) accumulates forever and never decays. Drives the Lifetime Rank and O.G./anniversary rewards.
GLOBAL SPENDABLE: the exchange currency, spendable anywhere on the platform (Active Tier, cosmetics, competition entries, stakes). Goes up and down; this is what purchases top up.

LOCAL PER-GAME: detailed, verifiable record of how points were earned in a specific game (already exists as lifetime Ludo points in local-points.js). Drives per-game skill reputation and gates game-specific unlocks.
All reason-tagged in the point_transactions audit; Supabase aggregation + on-chain record_points PDA as the verifiable layer.

Decided blind-spot: NO double-credit between local-spendable and global-spendable (one win must not mint two spendable balances). Game-exclusives are gated by local lifetime balance and charged from global spendable.

items.title: Two level systems: permanent Lifetime Rank + monthly Active Tier
items.summary: A permanent loyalty rank that never drops, plus a monthly spendable tier with win multipliers that gates competitions.
notes: LIFETIME RANK: permanent, earned from lifetime points + account age (example: 5,000 lifetime AND 1 month old -> Rank 2). Never drops, never lost. Unlocks O.G./legacy rewards and future specials.

ACTIVE TIER (SETTLED 2026-08-14): temporary, monthly, bought from spendable points. Deducts from the spendable balance. Ladder anchored to the 100-pt 1st-place win: Tier 1 free 1x, Tier 2 = 1,000 spendable/mo at 2x, Tier 3 = 2,500 spendable/mo at 3x, Tier 4 = 5,000 spendable/mo at 4x.

Multiplier math check (why these numbers): avg points per 4P game (100/50/20/10 even split) = 45; a casual player wins ~1 in 4 games, so ~2-3 games per win -> Tier 2 (1,000) is reachable by a few evenings of play a month, Tier 3 (2,500) by a steady player, Tier 4 (5,000) by a serious player or a purchase. That is a boost, not a paywall.
Multiplier applies to base match win points only (100 -> 200 / 300 / 400 at 2x/3x/4x), NEVER to stake returns, comp prizes or referral gifts.

PER-DAY MULTIPLIER CAP: at most +1,000 boosted points/day from the multiplier (about 10 extra 100-pt wins). Stops whales from minting infinite points; keeps sinks (comp entries, cosmetics) draining faster than multipliers mint.
Renews monthly or expires: if it lapses MID-competition, entry locks but the leaderboard keeps points earned within the window; re-up instantly restores entry.
Gates Earn Competitions. Level cost must stay attainable by play (daily, referral, giveaway) or it reads as a paywall instead of a boost.
Decided blind-spot: multipliers apply to base match rewards only (never stake returns) plus the per-day cap above, so sinks (comp entries, cosmetics) drain faster than multipliers mint.

items.title: Earn Competitions + brand-sponsored events with prize escrow
items.summary: Skilled entry competitions where winners' rewards are free, with brand-sponsored prize pools locked in escrow so prizes always pay out.
notes: Skilled entry (Active Tier gate + small spendable entry fee), NEVER pay-to-win: claiming won rewards is free (tennis analogy: pay a little to enter, win covers it, higher wins cover more).
Prizes from pooled entries + sponsor/brand top-ups + platform rake.

Brand events: PLATFORM 30% / WINNERS 70%. Prize LOCKED in a smart-contract escrow (PDAs on the ER program, same gfg-dice owner) BEFORE the event; winners claim by program logic automatically, so a brand can never promise and then stiff winners.
Proven Solana patterns: BracketChain escrow-vault PDAs, SkillOS permissionless sponsor pools, PYMSTR batch payouts. Build our own escrow PDA to avoid third-party custody.

Legal framing (mainnet): Ludo is a game of chance; keep entry predominantly earned-points + small, pay prizes in points, real value only via escrow with clear T&Cs; legal review before cash competitions.

items.title: Ads, purchases and monetization rails (no token, no app stores)
items.summary: Inline banners on the free tier only, higher tiers ad-free; players buy spendable points through the embedded wallet on-ramp with no Stripe or app stores.
notes: ADS: inline banners ONLY (never popups/interstitials that break the game), shown on the free tier; higher Active Tiers are ad-free. Level 1 sees a low-fill banner.
Web2 first: Google AdSense H5 Game Ads (easiest start), then Ezoic / Playwire / AdinPlay for gaming-optimized fill; web3 (Adshares / BigAds) only when crypto-native demand exists.
Honest revenue reality: Nigeria is Tier-3 traffic (CPM $1-4). Ads are a support line, not the business. Real sustain = competition rake + brand sponsorships + cosmetics + point purchases.

PURCHASES: no Stripe, no app stores. Player funds the embedded Dynamic wallet via on-ramp (card/bank in local currency), buys spendable points in-app; points minted SERVER-SIDE only after a verified on-chain payment.
The buy-to-join moment (Ludo King 10k tournament with 2.5k banked) is the conversion driver; soften it early with referral / giveaway / social-share earn paths.

items.title: Seven concrete revenue streams (the platform's sustain model)
items.summary: Seven honest ways the platform earns money to keep the games free for players. This list decides the build order: revenue first, features second.
notes: Stream 1, ON-RAMP (primary): players top up real money via the embedded Dynamic wallet on-ramp and buy spendable points server-side after a verified on-chain payment. Every other stream drains spendable, which recycles demand back into this one. The whole economy hinges on a trustworthy buy-flow.

Stream 2, BRAND EVENT RAKE 30/70: brands sponsor competitions; income = entry pools + brand fees. Platform keeps 30%, winners get 70%, prizes escrowed on-chain before the event so payouts are guaranteed.

Stream 3, ACTIVE TIER MONTHLY BUY: 1,000 / 2,500 / 5,000 spendable per month for 2x / 3x / 4x win multipliers. A spendable drain that funnels players back to the on-ramp; a future real-money subscription once payment rails mature.

Stream 4, AD NETWORKS (support line, honest): inline banners on the free tier + opt-in rewarded video for a few bonus points; higher tiers are ad-free. Nigeria is Tier-3 CPM $1-4: treat as support, never the business.
Stream 5, COSMETICS STORE (non-NFT): board themes, dice skins, avatar frames bought with spendable points. Pure sink with no token/NFT so no crash label; drains spendable and feeds the on-ramp.
Stream 6, STAKE MODE RAKE (optional, small): players stake spendable points in competitive matches, platform takes a small fixed rake per pot, winners claim the rest. Skilled-first, never pay-to-win.
Stream 7, TOURNAMENT LICENCE: communities and brands run their own hosted GlobalFolkGames events; platform charges a setup/hosting fee in spendable points or a small revenue share.

items.title: Core architecture: modular point layers + pluggable modules (game-agnostic)
items.summary: The platform is built as pluggable modules, not a rigid stack: the game, its pure local points, the 3 global ledgers, competitions, and sponsor escrow are each independent modules that slot together. No module is tailored to any single game.
notes: MODULE MAP (each independent + pluggable):

M1 Game core + proof of play. Per-game engine + on-chain VRF dice + verifiable roll. Knows NOTHING about points, tiers, comps. Ludo is the first M1; Ayo Olopon and 50+ games each become their own M1 instance

M2 Universal result seam (plug-and-play contract bus). The one integration contract between every game and every reward module. Every game ends with window.publishGameResult(); every reward module subscribes via window.onGameResult(). Standalone because it is the platform wiring, not a game and not a reward

M3 Local points (per game, PURE, on-chain). Only verified gameplay + win (proof-of-play gated). NO multiplier, NO purchase, NO bonus, NO giveaway, NO referral. Can never be diluted. Feeds in-game levels + future untransferable level NFT. On-chain PDA per game

M4 Global points (3 ledgers, site-wide, decoupled from how games are played): (a) GLOBAL PURE - strictly the sum of M3 local wins across ALL games, no multiplier, honest cross-game skill total; (b) GLOBAL LIFETIME (unspendable) - every point ever earned from ANY source (games, signup, giveaway, referral, sub multiplier); (c) GLOBAL SPENDABLE - the spendable split of lifetime. 2x/3x/4x Active Tier multiplier applies ONLY at M4 flow-up (lifetime + spendable), NEVER on M3 local or M4 pure. Purchases/signup/referral feed M4 only
M5 Monthly subscription (Active Tier). The money module; 2x/3x/4x multiplier applied at M4 flow-up. M6 Point sources (referral, giveaway, signup, social earn) - feed M4 only, never M3

M7 Competitions (standalone, game-agnostic). Entry config = points requirement + optional custom fields (e.g. phone number for airtime). Plugs into one/multiple/ALL games. Pluggable payout: airtime, escrow, manual. Runs fine with NO sponsor
M8 Sponsor escrow (OPTIONAL plugin, separate from M7). Brand-funded prize pool locked on-chain BEFORE the event, 30/70 rake at settle. A competition may use M8 or not

RULES: game + rewards separated (M1 never calls M4; M1 only emits into the seam M2); competition stands alone from sponsor (M7 needs no M8); local points never diluted (only M3 feed M4-pure and M4-lifetime-flow, always with a source tag like 'Ludo' / 'Ayo Olopon'); everything plugs in/interchangeably

S STAGES REDO: S0 = M1 Ludo whole + testable (on-chain dice, seam, local points, global flow-up). S1 = M4 global ledgers + tier multiplier applied at flow-up (M5). S2 = M7 competitions game-agnostic + M8 escrow as plugin. S3+ = on-ramp, cosmetics, ads, stake, licence (unchanged)
